tests.title: JEE Main Full Mock Test #01
tests.description: High-yield practice paper covering Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.

questions.question_text: For a first-order reaction, if the rate constant k is 6.93 × 10⁻³ s⁻¹, what is the half-life period (t₁/₂) of the reaction?
questions.explanation: For a first-order reaction, t₁/₂ = 0.693 / k = 0.693 / (6.93 × 10⁻³) = 100 seconds.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_text: A particle of mass m moves in a circular path of radius r with a uniform speed v. What is the work done by the centripetal force during one complete revolution?
questions.explanation: The centripetal force acts perpendicular to the instantaneous displacement at all points along the circular path, so W = F · d = F d cos(90°) = 0.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_text: What is the value of the limit: lim(x → 0) (sin 3x / tan 2x)?
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.question_text: Which of the following coordination compounds exhibits optical isomerism?
questions.explanation: cis-[Co(en)₂Cl₂]⁺ lacks a plane or center of symmetry, making its mirror image non-superimposable (optically active). Trans isomer has a plane of symmetry.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_text: In an AC circuit, the instantaneous current and voltage are given by I = 5 sin(100πt) A and V = 200 sin(100πt + π/3) V. Calculate the average power consumed in the circuit.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_text: If A and B are square matrices of the same order such that AB = A and BA = B, then A² + B² is equal to:
questions.explanation: A² = A(AB) = (AA)B = AB = A. Similarly B² = B. Therefore A² + B² = A + B.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.question_text: What is the major organic product formed when phenol reacts with chloroform and aqueous NaOH (Reimer-Tiemann reaction)?
questions.explanation: Reimer-Tiemann reaction converts phenol to o-hydroxybenzaldehyde (salicylaldehyde) via dichlorocarbene intermediate.
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_text: Two identical capacitors are connected in parallel and charged to a potential V. They are then disconnected and connected in series. What is the new potential difference across the combination?
questions.explanation: Each capacitor is charged to potential V. Connecting them in series adds their potential differences V + V = 2V.
questions.subject: Physics

questions.question_text: Find the number of words that can be formed from the letters of the word "TRIANGLE" such that the vowels always occupy odd places.
questions.explanation: Vowels = I, A, E (3 vowels). Total positions = 8 (Odd positions: 1, 3, 5, 7 - 4 places). 3 vowels can be arranged in 4 odd places in ⁴P₃ = 24 ways. The remaining 5 consonants fit in 5 remaining places in 5! = 120 ways. Total = 24 * 120 = 2880.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.question_text: Which noble gas has the highest boiling point at atmospheric pressure?
questions.explanation: Boiling point increases down Group 18 with increasing atomic mass and polarizability of London dispersion forces. Xenon has the highest boiling point among these.
questions.subject: Chemistry
